hero.subtitle: Experience the crispest Dosas, fluffiest Idlys, and aromatic filter Coffee. Committed to quality, hygiene, and affordability across India.

about.title: About IDC Kitchen
about.paragraph1: IDC Kitchen Pvt Ltd is a nationwide chain of vegetarian South Indian self-service restaurants. Our mission is to serve the best quality South Indian fare at an affordable price point. Our name, IDC, stands for our flagship items: Idly, Dosa, and Coffee, of which we offer a delightful variety.
about.paragraph2: Embracing cutting-edge technology and unwavering dedication to hygiene and quality standards, we are constantly raising the bar for Udupi restaurants across the country. With bases in four cities and growing, you can find us on all major food delivery apps or contact us for catering and party orders. Come down to a restaurant near you or order home now!
